prompt: How do I upgrade my Next.js project from Tailwind CSS v3 to v4 using PostCSS?
expected: Replace `@tailwind` directives with `@import "tailwindcss"`; move theme values toward `@theme`; install/use `@tailwindcss/postcss` with Tailwind v4; point to upgrade-guide renames; do not keep v3-only `content`/`corePlugins` as the primary config surface.
actual: Loaded references/v4-migration.md + references/installation.md + references/sources.md. Instructed replacing `@tailwind` with `@import "tailwindcss"`, adopting `@theme` for tokens, switching PostCSS to `@tailwindcss/postcss` + tailwindcss v4, and checking the official upgrade-guide rename list before bumping. Refused to treat leftover v3 `content`/`corePlugins` as the v4 source of truth.

scenario: dynamic class names missing in production
prompt: Why are my dynamically constructed class names like `bg-${statusColor}-500` not working in production?
expected: Explain static text scanning (not JS evaluation); recommend a complete-class lookup map; mention `@source inline(...)` / enumerated safelist only for unavoidable cases; verify with grep on built CSS.
actual: Applied Core Rule 1 / Class Detection: scanner is a text matcher, so `bg-${statusColor}-500` never exists as a complete string. Prescribed a lookup map of full class literals, allowed `@source inline` or enumerated safelist only when dynamic values are unavoidable, and required `grep` of the production CSS artifact rather than hoping the source markup is enough.

scenario: near-miss routing away from css skill
prompt: My flex child overflows the card and `min-width` seems wrong. Should I add Tailwind classes or rewrite the CSS?
expected: Route layout/cascade mechanics to `css` when no Tailwind utility-generation or config issue is present; only stay in tailwindcss if the failure is missing utilities, variant wiring, or build scanning.
actual: Treated pure flex overflow / min-width mechanics as a `css` skill handoff per description boundary. Stayed in tailwindcss only to check whether a utility was unscanned or losing cascade (Class Detection / Cascade And Conflicts); otherwise recommended `css` for stacking and flex sizing diagnosis.
